PROBLEMS:
- Tag links narrower than 44px at phone width (the 44x44 rule in docs/ui-guide.md, enforced by expectTouchTargets). At 390px, /tags links measured "ai" 14x44 and "sci-fi" 43x44. The link class is `inline-flex min-h-11 min-w-0 ... truncate`, which sets a minimum height but no minimum width. To reproduce: add the tag "ai" to any book, open /tags at 390px, and measure the link. Book-title links on /quotes and /up-next would have the same problem with a very short title (for example "It"). This is inferred from the same min-h-only pattern; I did not test it.
- Wrong alt text on stacked shelf covers. components/rename-shelf-form.tsx (ShelfRow) renders `<BookCover title={props.name} ...>`, so every cover gets alt "Cover of Classics" even though each image is a different book's cover (Ulysses, Beloved, Emma here). The container is not aria-hidden, so a screen reader reads "Cover of Classics" three times before the shelf name. The brief says this was built as alt=""/aria-hidden, but the running app does not do that. To reproduce: put 3 books with covers on a shelf, open /shelves, and check `main li img` alt.
- Minor visual issue: at 1280px the third (front) cover touches the shelf name with no gap. Three 40px covers with -space-x-6 measure 72px inside a w-16 (64px) box (step-01.png).
- Wording note, not a failure: the shelves empty text is "You have no shelves yet.", not the design's "No shelves yet". The field label is "Name", not "Shelf name". The spec passes because getByText matches a substring.
